reports.type.certification_status.title: Certification Status Report
reports.type.certification_status.descri: Certification status of farmers and societies — covers certificate validity, audit outcomes and pending renewals for the selected season.
reports.type.corrective_actions.title: Corrective Actions Report
reports.type.corrective_actions.descript: Outstanding corrective actions from inspection visits — grouped by parcel and farmer, with due dates and current status.
reports.type.eudr_compliance.title: EUDR Compliance Report
reports.type.eudr_compliance.description: EUDR due-diligence statement bundle — parcel-level geolocation, risk assessment outcomes and deforestation evidence per cooperative.
reports.type.farmer_coaching_v3.title: Farmer Coaching Report (v3)
reports.type.farmer_coaching_v3.descript: Coaching visits across the selected season — GAP, IPM, EUDR and CLMRS scores per farmer with follow-up flags.
reports.type.gmr_template.title: GMR Template
reports.type.gmr_template.description: Group management record template — pre-filled with the active season, society and program rows ready for downstream submission.
reports.type.traceability_report.title: Traceability Report Template
reports.type.traceability_report.descrip: End-to-end lot trace — primary + secondary evacuations linked to source farmers, with weight and grade reconciliation.
reports.type.training_attendance.title: Training Attendance Register
reports.type.training_attendance.descrip: Training attendance — one row per participant per session, with program, trainer, topics, gender totals, consent and trainer evaluation.
